meanings: To move about, to be in a state of motion or commotion or agitation, to shake or shake about, to wobble/totter/waggle/nod, to smite or sever with a sword, to be light/active/agile/brisk/lively/sprightly/sharp/quick in intellect (applied to a boy).

occurrences.verseArabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ
occurrences.verseTransliteration: Lâ tuharrik bihî lisâneke li ta’cele bihî.
occurrences.verseMeaning: Onu aceleye getiresin diye dilini onunla hareketlendirme!
